title: Woolweaves
description: A few wool blocks based on various 2-Bit Lospec Palettes.
body:
A Forge MCreator Mod, which introduces several uniquely colored wool building blocks, with more to come with future updates. Besides that, the mod doesn't introduce any other things.

The recipe to craft a Woolweave Patch:

![The recipe for crafting a Wool-weave Patch, having 1 string in each corner of the crafting grid.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/345797f2c3a239fe9c14e3194a35b14563d99c90.png)

From there, you can stonecut it into the avaliable Woolweaves.

Lospec Palettes Used:

[https://lospec.com/palette-list/hollow](https://lospec.com/palette-list/hollow) (Bitter Woolweave)

[https://lospec.com/palette-list/blk-aqu4](https://lospec.com/palette-list/blk-aqu4) (Aqueous Woolweave)
